purpose: Patch-independent sound assignment ideas; these are descriptive roles, not guaranteed Logic factory preset names.

Harmonic Bed.choose: Warm vintage organ, e-piano or soft analog polysynth
Harmonic Bed.performance: Use velocity-sensitive patch or adjust velocity-to-filter if supported
Harmonic Bed.suggested_processing: Light chorus, high-pass below bass region, subtle room reverb

Melodic Bass.choose: Picked electric bass or round finger-style bass
Melodic Bass.performance: Shorter pickup notes, strong phrase starts, occasional higher-register counterlines
Melodic Bass.suggested_processing: Modest compression, mild upper-mid saturation; preserve pitch definition

Sub Sequence.choose: Sine/triangle or compact mono analog synth
Sub Sequence.suggested_processing: Mono low end, minimal reverb, tame resonance

Picked Guitar.choose: Clean lightly muted guitar, sampled picked guitar, or crisp pluck synth
Picked Guitar.performance: Standard-tuning voicings in composition manifest; alternating accents
Picked Guitar.suggested_processing: Chorus or very short delay, control transients, medium stereo position

Reply Guitar.choose: Clean guitar of a different pickup/timbre than first part
Reply Guitar.suggested_processing: Opposite pan from picked guitar, smaller reverb

Four Note Hook.choose: Clean electric guitar lead, breathy lead synth or sparse electric piano
Four Note Hook.performance: Phrase-based velocity; leave unplayed bars for a vocal
Four Note Hook.suggested_processing: Slow chorus or modest delay with quiet repeats

Ghost Keys.choose: FM bell, tape-softened synth or gentle sine lead
Ghost Keys.suggested_processing: Soft low pass, modulation, ambient decay

Drum Engine.choose: GM-compatible drum machine kit or remapped Logic Drum Machine Designer pads
Drum Engine.performance: Separate kicks/snares/ghost hits by velocity; adjust kit if GM mapping differs
Drum Engine.suggested_processing: Dry kick and snare, gentle bus glue, hats lower than you think

patch_independence: No Program Changes, CC0, or CC32 events are generated. Other safe CCs are not inserted by the v3 composer.
limitations: MIDI alone cannot create tape hiss, chorus tone, actual feedback, room acoustics, or singer phrasing. Velocity-layer realism depends on the selected instrument.
